blind.description: A stylized fantasy emblem or trophy consisting of an upright sword positioned in front of a blue kite-style shield, all supported by a faceted octagonal tiered plinth. The sword has a silver blade and crossguard with a blue gem inlay and wrapped blue grip with a pommel gem. The shield features silver wing-like trims on a royal blue background. All surfaces are solid, cleanly modeled, and fully textured in a stylized fantasy game art style with no disconnected or melted geometry.
blind.from_above: An elongated octagonal tiered pedestal showing the crossguard, pommel, and top rim of the shield, accompanied by a clear sword-and-shield shadow.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/4 the height of the figure (around 1.3 to 1.5 feet tall) and roughly 6 to 8 inches wide.

notes: Height proportion is taller than catalog ratio, but reads clearly as requested
